mechanism: Polyethylene glycol enhances gastrointestinal motility and fluid secretion, which may reduce scopolamine absorption and efficacy when given orally, while scopolamine's anticholinergic effects may reduce PEG bowel transit effectiveness.
action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; consider alternative antiemetic if scopolamine efficacy is critical, or use transdermal scopolamine to bypass GI absorption issues.
